tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search real-estate listings published on new.estate (homes, apartments, plots, commercial property for sale or rent in many countries). Returns matching listings with price, area, location and the URL of each listing page. The accepted property type and country values are listed by get_catalog. The

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing published on new.estate: description, photos, features and every characteristic shown on the listing page, including country-specific fields, named in the requested language. Takes a listing id from search_listings or the URL of a listing page. Contact details are not ret

tools.name: find_similar_listings
tools.description: Listings on new.estate similar to the given one (same type and transaction, comparable price, area and location). For a unit in a development, returns the other units of that development.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Values accepted by search_listings: countries that have listings (with counts), property types, transaction types, features, sort orders and price currencies, named in the requested language.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find listings on new.estate by place name. Returns ids, titles and URLs; the full text of a listing is available from fetch. Filters such as price, size or property type are available in search_listings.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of one new.estate listing by id from search, with its URL for citation.

tools.name: get_publishing_info
tools.description: How owners, brokers, agencies and developers publish real estate listings on new.estate: what a free account includes, the paid plans with prices in EUR and their features (CRM, inquiry inbox, teams, developments, calendar, statistics), credit costs, and the sign-up, pricing and guide URLs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, search, fetch, get_publishing_info · Private data: get_listing · Public sink: get_publishing_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, search, fetch, get_publishing_info · Private data: get_listing · Public sink: get_publishing_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
